distanthorizons.setting.enabled.tooltip: Toggle Distant Horizons level-of-detail terrain rendering.
distanthorizons.setting.render_distance_: Maximum distance in chunks at which Distant Horizons renders simplified terrain.
distanthorizons.setting.horizontal_quali: Controls how quickly distant terrain transitions to coarser detail levels.
distanthorizons.setting.vertical_quality: Maximum stacked vertical layers kept per column for caves, overhangs, arches and Nether caverns.
distanthorizons.setting.distant_generati: Sample terrain beyond loaded chunks using the world generator.
Worldgen detail level for distant ungenerated chunks (Surface, Carvers, Features or Full Light).
distanthorizons.setting.cave_culling_ena: Skip hidden underground cave layers below the cave culling height in sunlit dimensions.
distanthorizons.setting.cave_culling_hei: Y level below which hidden underground caves are culled from distant terrain.
distanthorizons.setting.fog_enabled.tool: Blend distant terrain smoothly into the horizon sky fog.
distanthorizons.setting.noise_enabled.to: Add subtle per-block luminance variation to untextured distant terrain.
Strength of surface texture variation on distant terrain.
distanthorizons.setting.overdraw_prevent: Fraction of vanilla render distance kept clear before starting LOD transition.
distanthorizons.setting.fade_enabled.too: Dither-fade LOD terrain smoothly across the vanilla render distance boundary.
Shade distant terrain faces by direction and height.
distanthorizons.setting.brightness_multi: Scales distant terrain brightness relative to vanilla lighting.
distanthorizons.setting.ssao_enabled.too: Apply screen-space ambient occlusion to distant LOD terrain valleys and overhangs.
distanthorizons.setting.ssao_quality.too: Sample count for distant screen-space ambient occlusion.
distanthorizons.setting.ssao_strength.to: Intensity of distant ambient occlusion shading.
distanthorizons.setting.disable_vanilla_: Extend vanilla atmospheric render-distance fog so Distant Horizons handles horizon fog without double-fogging.
distanthorizons.setting.fog_falloff.tool: Distance falloff curve for Distant Horizons atmospheric fog.
distanthorizons.setting.fog_spherical.to: Use 3D spherical camera distance instead of horizontal cylindrical distance for distant fog.
distanthorizons.setting.height_fog_enabl: Blend atmospheric valley mist relative to the height fog base altitude.
distanthorizons.setting.height_fog_base_: World Y altitude below which valley height fog thickens.
distanthorizons.setting.height_fog_mix_m: How distance fog and height fog combine.
distanthorizons.setting.clouds_enabled.t: Render drifting 3D cloud layers out to the Distant Horizons render distance.
distanthorizons.setting.beacon_beams_ena: Render glowing beacon beams beyond vanilla render distance.
distanthorizons.setting.debug_mode.toolt: Diagnostic visualization mode for LOD detail levels, generation provenance, lighting, or cell wireframes.
distanthorizons.command.radius_set: Distant Horizons render distance set to %s chunks.
distanthorizons.command.cleared: Cleared %s cached Distant Horizons sections in the active dimension.
distanthorizons.command.remeshed: Queued %s Distant Horizons sections for re-meshing.
distanthorizons.command.status_line: Distant Horizons [%s] dim=%s radius=%sch sections=%s ready=%s drawn=%s quads=%s weather=%s
distanthorizons.command.debug_set: Distant Horizons debug mode set to %s.
